comparison.tools: read-only files and evidence write, no live Stitch
limits: six cases in one isolated session per arm, not independent repeated trials
human direction supplied in prose, not screenshots
no statistical or aesthetic superiority claim

checks: Keeps approved white/purple/system typography rather than imposing new palette/font/texture
Changes secondary-action emphasis without moving navigation or changing medical facts
Proposes bounded variant and approval/safety sequence without claiming write executed
Borrows hierarchy but not orange palette/illustrations
Separates proposed instruction from execution; does not invent mode parameters
Does not infer a defect or force decoration/rethink
No mandatory moodboard/external reference for sufficient context
Separates preference/unknowns from observed proof, no unnecessary write
No variant/design system/write creation after explicit no-change decision
Reports existing audit evidence as supplied, not independently executed
Does not require preservation of nonexistent baseline
Plans lint/design system/generation/review under original-safe and human direction gates
Allows requested section reorganization without changing facts/navigation
Retains original and respects scoped approval
Does not present unseen visual diagnosis as screenshot observation
